description: Issue #50 open items. ONE connection in the default library (<USER>2). Staging as in issue50-force (V27STG + CPYTOSTMF), then TXLEGACY LANG(*RPGLE) FORCE(*YES) from RPG III. (1) ILE counterpart of RPG1031: ticket-1 fix on JU0900C, baseline JU0900C *TEST as a submitted job (tag RBASE), then a JUCHUM header J00000 appended AT THE END (plus a valid JUCHUD line J00000/1/P00001/1) and the same job again (tag RFAIL); job log message ids in VFYJ50/VFYJ50X, print in VFYPRBASE/VFYPRFAIL; rows deleted and JU0900C restored from C_JU0900C afterwards. (2) 04-24 RNQ0202/RNX0100: V50NB1 CALLs a missing program, V50NB2 CALLs V50DIV (divide by zero), both without error indicator 85, submitted with INQMSGRPY(*DFT) (tags NB1, NB2). (3) CPYSRCF with TOMBR(JU0300C) exactly as lesson 10-02 shows it, line 402 (QRPGSRC) and line 454 (QRPGLE112): backup of an existing JU0300C into V50JCB1/V50JCB2, the lesson command, row counts in VFY50MK, restore. LAST: restore the RPG III legacy system (TXLEGST/TXLEGLNG deleted, LANG(*RPG), no FORCE) and TXRESET. PRECOND: DBVER=1, legacy system RPG III. Results: collect sections VFY50MK, VFYJ50, VFYJ50X plus sections.vfylog. HONEST LIMITS: single-library simulation; a submitted job that hangs is ended with ENDJOB, which loses its in-job job log copy (VFY50MK row JOB-<name> then shows 1/<status>).

steps.cmd: DLTDTAARA DTAARA(&LIB/TXLEGLNG)

steps.label: RESTORE
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/V27RUN) PARM('LEGRPG' '&LIB')

steps.label: RESET2
steps.cmd: &LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)

steps.label: ATTZ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''ATTR'', OBJNAME CONCAT ''='' CONCAT COALESCE(OBJATTRIBUTE, ''-'') FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''ZA0500'', ''JU0300'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: LNGZ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''TXLEGLNG'', COALESCE(DATA_AREA_VALUE, ''-'') FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DATA_AREA_INFO(DATA_AREA_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'', DATA_AREA_NAME => ''TXLEGLNG'')) X') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CNTZM
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''JUCHUM-ROWS'', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM &LIB/JUCHUM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CNTZD
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''JUCHUD-ROWS'', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM &LIB/JUCHUD') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: STKZ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''ZAIKOM-SUM'', CHAR(SUM(ZASU)) FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: STKZR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''ZAIKOM-ROWS'', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SRZ
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY50MK (TAG, K, V) SELECT ''Z-FINAL'', ''V50-MEMBERS'', TABLE_NAME CONCAT ''/'' CONCAT TABLE_PARTITION FROM QSYS2.SYSPARTITIONSTAT WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND TABLE_PARTITION IN (''JU0300C'', ''V50JCB1'', ''V50JCB2'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.sql: SELECT TS, TAG, K, V FROM &LIB/VFY50MK ORDER BY TS
SELECT TAG, SEQ, MID, TXT FROM &LIB/VFYJ50 ORDER BY TAG, SEQ
SELECT TAG, SEQ, MTYPE, SEV, FPGM, FINS, TPGM, TINS, MID FROM &LIB/VFYJ50X ORDER BY TAG, SEQ
SELECT DATA_AREA_LIBRARY, DATA_AREA_NAME, DATA_AREA_VALUE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DATA_AREA_INFO(DATA_AREA_LIBRARY => '&LIB', DATA_AREA_NAME => 'TXLEGLNG')) X

SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*PGM')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('ZA0500', 'JU0300', 'TK0100', 'JU0900C', 'V50NB1', 'V50NB2', 'V50DIV') ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT 'JUCHUM' AS T, COUNT(*) AS N FROM &LIB/JUCHUM UNION ALL SELECT 'JUCHUD', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/JUCHUD UNION ALL SELECT 'ZAIKOM', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM ORDER BY ZASHO
